_about: The real size of each original, height x width in cm, told to the model as a fact at levels 2 to 4 (tools/paint/real-size.mjs). It never sizes the sheet: every picture is painted on the standard area (tools/paint/sheet-rule.mjs). nominal: a generated picture, which has no real size; part: the picture painted is a part of the original, whose whole size this is. sheet: the museum's figure for the sheet, where the picture's file has other proportions (told as the museum's figure). A subject's record in the registry may carry its own realSize, which is read first. A subject not listed is told nothing about the original's size.
